name: fix-item-rebuild-0.1.24
desc: Item Rebuild 0.1.24: route charts found from PrefabLane.lineMap (no fixed 130001-130056 range), so City Editor route charts are covered.
commits: Rules.AutoRoute no longer uses the fixed 130001-130056 range: a route chart is any item a PrefabLane row's lineMap points to (EntryPoint.LaneOf, read from the game table). Charts added by City Editor (core newRow) get the same shop hiding/refusal and capacity exclusion. 12007/12039-12042 now count as route charts too (sold nowhere; excluded from logical bag capacity). An empty lane table is not cached. Hooks unchanged. PASS 5636.
